done_when: Sample-data mode is on only when forge.toml says sample_data = true; a client repo whose old sign-off record says sample data but whose forge.toml has no sample_data setting runs its tests at close and in forge test, and close no longer says Ready without tests
why: After an upgrade, close skips tests and CI and says Ready in a real client app, and forge test says no test command is set, because repo.sample_data falls back to an old sign-off record that says sample_data: true while forge.toml has stage = prototype and no sample_data setting (issues 1401 and 1400)
